name: Logos Carousel
summary: React carousel component that cycles sponsor and brand logos column by column in a staggered wave.
description: A shadcn-registry component for logo walls: the grid cycles through logos column by column in a staggered wave, with prefers-reduced-motion replacing the slide and blur with a plain opacity cross-fade, and pausing while the page is hidden or the carousel is off screen. Documented with an API reference, accessibility notes on WCAG 2.2.2 auto-updating content, and installation via npx shadcn add @ncdai/logos-carousel; inspired by Devouring Details.
contains: cycles logos column by column in a staggered wave
prefers-reduced-motion: slide and blur replaced by a plain opacity cross-fade
pauses while the page is hidden or the carousel is off screen
WCAG 2.2.2 note: add a pause control or keep the carousel decorative
